'''Sabacc Squadron''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] composed of [[StarViper Mk. II]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was assigned to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jerid Sykes]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[End of Days]]'' and was part of the Consortium fleet that [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|battled]] the pirate fleet of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].<ref name="MotPQ" />
